step: Step 1: ceiling gate (training labels; diagnostic only)
calibration: minmax fitted on training scores, not clipped
k_rule: K = ceil(budget * n), at least 1 (metrics.budget_k); K_train over n_train for tuning and selection, K_test over n_test for evaluation; ties at the K-th score split in expectation
tie_rules: weight vectors tied on training FP@K: largest single weight, then grid order; label-selected member tied on training FP@K: first in member order; dataset outcome on seed means rounded to 9 decimals

gate.rule: pass if tuned weights have fewer test false alarms than the label-selected member on more datasets than the reverse (seed means; ties not counted)

note: training labels used for tuning and member selection (diagnostic); test labels only for evaluation and the oracle references; ADBench only
